Author: Author
PatchHint: Check an @@ row for a whole hunk, or check individual + / − lines.
SelectFile: Select a file to view its diff
LargeDiff: More than 1 MB or 20,000 lines. Preview paused.
SnapshotHint: Restore creates a new snapshot for redo. Local snapshots cannot undo remote changes.
Untrusted: Untrusted repository: external hooks and filters are restricted.
ResolveHint: Select conflict files in Changes. Review the chosen version, then mark resolved.
RequiredText: Type the required text to confirm
CredentialHint: Credentials go directly to Git and are never stored or logged.
BranchRequired: Select or enter a branch name.
SelectPatch: Select a hunk or changed line first.
SelectWorktreeDiff: Select a working-tree text diff first.
PatchModeRequired: Stage patches from unstaged diff. To unstage, enable Show staged diff first.
BinaryConflict: Binary conflict: text editing is unavailable. Choose a full version or use an external merge tool.
DiffLoading: Wait for the current file diff to load, then select its patch.
ConflictHelp: Review base / ours / theirs, then resolve individual sections or edit the result. Save, review the diff, and mark resolved.
ConflictUnavailable: Select an editable text conflict first.
SaveConflictFirst: Save the edited merge result before marking resolved.
GitPathHint: Choose git.exe or an extracted Portable Git folder (Git 2.40+). Leave blank to search PortableGit/Git next to this app, then PATH. System PATH changes are unnecessary.
AppearanceSaveFailed: Could not save. The previous palette is unchanged.
AppearanceHint: Choose a palette to apply it immediately. Your selection is saved for the next launch.
AdvancedResetHint: Soft moves HEAD; Mixed also resets the index; Hard also replaces the working tree, with confirmation and a recovery snapshot.
AdvancedStashHint: Save tracked working-tree and index changes. Optionally include untracked files.
AdvancedRemoteHint: Select a remote to view every URL. Fetch URLs and optional push URLs are managed separately. Changes create recovery snapshots.
AdvancedFirstCannotSquash: The first retained commit cannot be Squash or Fixup.
AdvancedLoadPlanFirst: Load a complete plan for the current upstream first.
AdvancedAnnotated: Annotated tag (unchecked creates a lightweight tag)
AdvancedUpstream: Rebase upstream, e.g. main or HEAD~3
AdvancedFileLoaded: Loaded line attribution and rename-following file history.
AdvancedRewordRequired: Each Reword step needs a message.
AdvancedWait: An operation is still running. Wait for it to finish.
AdvancedReflogHint: Select an entry to use its full object ID as the target in Commit actions and Tags.
AdvancedNoOperation: There is no active operation supporting this action.
AdvancedStepMessage: Message: required for Reword; optional override for Squash
AdvancedActiveHint: An operation is active. Resolve and stage conflicts in the main window, then refresh here to continue.
AdvancedRebaseHint: Enter an upstream and load the complete plan. Steps run from top to bottom. Drag the handle or use Move up/down. Reword needs a message; Edit pauses for changes.
AdvancedHistoryHint: Enter a full SHA, branch, tag, or reflog target. Cherry-pick copies a commit; Revert adds an inverse commit.
AdvancedHint: Choose an action and target. The backend creates recovery snapshots and requests confirmation according to risk.
AdvancedResolveFirst: Resolve and stage conflicts before continuing.
AdvancedPushUrl: Set push URL (unchecked sets fetch URL)
ToolsHint: Select a tool. Trust and risk confirmations are handled before a write begins.
ToolsWait: Wait for the active operation before writing or closing.
ToolsSubmoduleBoundary: Changes affect the parent repository. Child working directories remain separate; commit or stash child edits before updating or deinitializing.
ToolsSubmodulePath: Submodule path relative to the repository
ToolsWorktreeBoundary: Worktree lifecycle has no snapshot undo. Removal requires a clean, unlocked worktree and explicit confirmation; no force removal is used.
ToolsWorktreeBranch: New branch name (leave empty to use an existing revision)
ToolsLfsBoundary: Install Git LFS for this repository only. Track/untrack updates .gitattributes; fetch and pull use your configured remote and credentials. History is not rewritten.
ToolsBisectBoundary: Manually test the checked-out revision, then mark it good, bad, or skipped. Reset returns to the original branch; this tool never runs a test command.
ToolsSparseBoundary: Sparse checkout changes which tracked files appear on disk. A recovery snapshot preserves configuration, index flags, and materialized files.
ToolsSparsePatterns: Directories or patterns — one per line
ToolsSparsePatternHint: Cone mode accepts repository-relative directories. Disable cone mode to enter Git sparse-checkout patterns. Spaces remain part of each pattern.
ToolsPatternsRequired: Enter at least one pattern, one per line.
ToolsSignTag: Sign annotated tag using configured Git signing
ShortcutHint: Shortcuts are scoped to each window. Enter a gesture such as Ctrl+Shift+K and save that row; leave it blank to unbind. Text editing and navigation keys are reserved.
ShortcutReserved: This key is reserved for text editing or navigation. Choose another combination.
ShortcutDuplicate: Another command in this window already uses this shortcut.
ShortcutSaveFailed: Unable to save interface preferences. Check file permissions.
GraphName: Commit history. Use arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End to select commits.
TerminalInput: Enter a command; press Enter to execute
TerminalHelp: Persistent line shell using this repository and selected Git. Close it before GUI writes. VT/full-screen editors are unsupported; use external tools for vim/top.
EncodingUnreadable: Unable to decode reliably; replacement characters shown
HelpCredentialsHelp: Check the remote URL and Git Credential Manager/SSH settings. Retry the operation to request credentials. Do not put tokens in URLs or share credentials.
HelpLockHelp: Check for running Git, editor, or terminal processes. Never delete a lock owned by an active process. This app does not remove locks automatically; inspect Git output after confirming the owning process has exited.
HelpPrune: Connect drives that contain other worktrees first. Repository tools → Worktrees → Prune stale entries requests confirmation and removes all stale unlocked records, not just this entry.
HelpShowOutput: Expand actual commands and output in the main or repository tools window. The original error is retained and can be copied for inspection.
HelpStash: Save and review working files, then use Stash in Advanced. Choose whether to include untracked files. Changes are never stashed or discarded automatically.
HelpResolveConflicts: Return to the main window, select each conflicted file, review and save the result, then mark it resolved before continuing.
HelpRetry: Review network and repository state before retrying.
HelpFetch: Fetch remote state, then review the commit graph.
HelpPull: Review remote history and working files. Pull retains its existing checks and confirmations.
RetryWithoutHooksDetails: The commit hook rejected this commit. Retry the same reviewed commit once with --no-verify? This skips Git pre-commit and commit-msg hooks. Review their output first; signing, fresh validation and a recovery snapshot still apply.
